text:
Riley (People Ops): quick brainstorm 11 1-minute pack for managers: single-line goal headlines + a 1-line evidence cue + a one-step coaching prompt. want something copy-paste friendly for 1:1s and review forms. drop examples or anti-patterns.

Noah: simple template i use: HEADLINE - METRIC + WHEN
Example: "Cut model cold-start time by 22% this quarter."
Evidence: "Measured via load-test job X; median cold-start dropped from 9s to 7s."
Coaching prompt: "Who needs to be involved to make this repeatable?"

Priya: another flavor for product/eng:
Headline: "Lifted onboarding activation by 10% in 4 weeks."
Evidence: "A/B of the new flow, cohort analysis in Mixpanel."
Prompt: "Plan one experiment to iterate next week."

Devon: IC self-review starter (pasteable):
- "Headline: I improved caching strategy to reduce p95 latency by 15%."
- "Evidence: rollout notes + deploy tag, p95 from /metrics."
- "Next step: document config and run 2 knowledge shares."

Riley (People Ops): manager micro-comments (one-liners to paste):
- "Nice measurable outcome; can you call out the dependency and owner?"
- "Solid evidence; let's set a checkpoint in 2 weeks to validate stability."

HR Bot: slack DM template to request a quick pre-meeting note:
```
Hey <name> - quick favor before our 1:1: drop a one-line goal headline + one sentence evidence + one blocker (if any). Example:
- Headline: Reduced avg infer time by 12% this month.
- Evidence: bench + prod metrics.
- Blocker: need infra time to automate tests.
Thanks!
```

Noah: anti-patterns worth flagging:
- Vague headlines without numbers ("improved infra").
- Long logs or task lists instead of outcome + signal.

Priya: tiny rubric for managers (use in quick reviews):
- Outcome: Strong/Moderate/Weak (one-line why)
- Evidence: Clear/Partial/Missing
- Next step: single action (who + what + by when)

Devon: paste-ready rapid praise line: "Great ownership here 1 clear impact and shipping velocity. Would love a short playbook to reproduce."

Riley (People Ops): perfect. i'll bundle these into a one-page "pastepack" and share in the handbook. if folks have one more fast example (different domain: hiring ops, benefits, policy) drop it here.

Priya: quick hiring ops example:
Headline: "Reduced time-to-offer from 28 to 18 days for infra roles this quarter."
Evidence: "Process changes: standardized scorecard + 24h interviewer scheduling window."
Prompt: "Can you map the blocker that still causes delays?"

Riley (People Ops): awesome, thanks! posting the pack in #handbook later today. :rocket:
